name: Sitelas
summary: A website builder for AI agents: describe your site to Claude, ChatGPT or your own agent and it designs, publishes and runs pages, forms and SEO.
description: A website builder for AI agents: describe your site to Claude, ChatGPT or your own agent and it designs, publishes and runs pages, forms and SEO.

pricing.details: Free forever (1 live site on a sitelas.com subdomain, 3,000 visits/month, 1,000 one-time AI credits). Pro 8 €/month or 80 €/year per site (your own domain, no badge, 30,000 visits/month).
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Website builder designed for AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code)
Full visual builder, forms and collections
Custom domain and SSL on Pro
Free live site on a subdomain

howToUse.description: Sign up free on sitelas.com, connect your AI assistant or use the visual builder, describe your site and publish it on a subdomain; upgrade to Pro to use your own domain.
